title: Cross-browser responsive QA: token collisions, touch targets, and chart/table rendering anomalies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: triage and prioritize a focused sweep of cross-browser and responsive regressions impacting the UI kit (tokens, buttons, tables, charts). Scope covers recent customer reports and internal regression test failures on Safari (iOS/macOS), Firefox (desktop/mobile), and mobile Chrome. Deliverables: reproducibility matrix, design fixes or recommended workarounds, frontend PRs, updated token guidance, and verification across our BrowserStack matrix. Acceptance criteria: (1) All listed issues either have a reproducible bug+owner or an agreed technical/design workaround, (2) fixes merged or an implementation plan exists for P0/P1 items, (3) regression e2e tests added for high-risk cases, (4) updated notes in the UI Kit Confluence page.
qa_findings: BTN-HIT-001: iOS Safari (iPhone 12/13/14) — dense token scale reduces button hit target under 44px when buttons are inside tight token groups. Steps: open /components/buttons in mobile preview, apply token scale=compact, tap targets inconsistent. Severity: medium. Repro: 8/10. Suggested owner: frontend + design pattern team. Workaround: increase padding token or add a min-touch css rule.

TABLE-KB-002: iOS Safari — sticky table header jumps when virtual keyboard appears (form inline in row). Steps: open data table, focus input in a row on iOS; header reflow observed and row highlight misaligned. Severity: high (affects form-heavy dashboards). Repro: 6/10. Suggested owner: eng/runtime + frontend. Note: may be related to position: sticky + safe-area-inset handling.

CHART-FX-003: Firefox (Linux and macOS, DPR=2) — canvas line charts appear blurry/pixelated at high-DPR when using CSS scaling instead of backing store scaling. Steps: charts page, zoom 100% on DPR=2. Severity: medium. Fix candidate: adjust canvas width/height by devicePixelRatio and scale context, or render SVG for small-chart variants.

TOKEN-RTL-004: Firefox mobile (Android) — token labels wrap and overlap in RTL layouts for multi-line tokens. Steps: set locale=ar, open token list. Severity: low-medium (visible UI regression). Suggested owner: design tokens + frontend i18n.

SVG-SHADOW-005: Android Chrome — complex SVG drop shadows trigger heavy repaint in large tables (scrolly jank). Steps: open large table with chart thumbnails. Severity: low but causes jank in heavy pages. Mitigation: replace heavy SVG filters with CSS shadows or pre-render thumbnails.

AXIS-OVERLAP-006: Responsive charts at <=320px viewport — axis tick labels overlap and are not collapsed/ellipsized. Steps: resize to narrow viewport, observe x-axis on line chart. Severity: medium. Acceptance fix: implement tick sampling or rotate labels and add responsive breakpoints.

HOVER-Z-INDEX-007: Safari macOS/iOS — table row hover outline is visually overridden by -webkit-tap-highlight or stacking context on nested components. Steps: hover/long-press table rows. Severity: low. Owner: frontend. Quick fix: explicit z-index and pointer-events adjustments.

FONT-SMOOTH-008: Safari macOS — variable font rendering differences cause weight shifts at specific token sizes (12/13px). Steps: compare token labels between Chrome/Firefox/Safari. Severity: low visual fidelity. Note: may require font-variant-settings adjustment and explicit letter-spacing.

SCROLL-SNAP-009: Mobile Safari — snap-to-item in token carousel jumps after orientation change. Steps: rotate device after interacting with token carousel. Severity: low-medium. Suggested owner: frontend carousel component.

EMBED-IMG-010: All browsers — embedded emoji fallback in tokens misalign baseline in compact token rows. Steps: create token with emoji and long label, compact mode. Severity: low. Fix: baseline-align via CSS and fallback font stack.
